summary_en: Wacom's board endorsed an MBO by MP-2611 K.K. at a purchase price to be determined, contingent on antitrust clearance from Japan, Taiwan, and Australia, plus investment screening approvals from Japan, Germany, and Bulgaria. The tender offer is targeted to commence in mid-February 2027 pending regulatory approvals. Wacom will delist upon completion.
title_en: Notice Regarding Opinion on Implementation of MBO and Scheduled Commencement of Tender Offer and Recommendation of Application
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, Wacom's board of directors resolved to endorse an MBO transaction whereby MP-2611 K.K. (a special purpose vehicle backed by MBKP Fund) will launch a tender offer for all issued and outstanding Wacom shares and American Depositary Shares, with the aim of acquiring 100% ownership and delisting the company from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market. The board recommended that shareholders and ADS holders tender their shares.

The tender offer is conditional upon obtaining all required regulatory approvals and clearances, including antitrust filings under the competition laws of Japan, Taiwan, and Australia, as well as investment screening approvals under the investment regulations of Japan, Germany, and Bulgaria. SESP (Samsung Electronics Singapore Pte. Ltd.), which currently owns 8,398,400 shares (6.32% ownership), has entered into a transaction agreement with MBKP Fund. The board also established a special committee to advise on the transaction.

The bidder targets commencement of the tender offer in mid-February 2027, pending completion of regulatory submissions and clearances. The board stated it will reaffirm its support when the tender offer actually commences. The specific tender price was not disclosed in this announcement, as these represent preliminary procedural steps subject to obtaining necessary regulatory clearances.
